values.note: County: 'We have a two night minimum for reservations on the weekends'; Campspot also asked for 2 nights from a Tuesday in October 2026. Payment in full holds a reservation; no refunds, but rain checks good for a year if notified 4 days ahead. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 11 am; the gate is locked at night (campers get the combination).

booking.source: https://www.rowancountync.gov/430/Camping ('We have a two night minimum for reservations on the weekends. Payment in full must be made to hold reservations.
